main.description: A trail or a road that segments lie on (segments/segment-paths): public, published only by the segment importer, and indexed only from its repo. Pure grouping: the AppView works out which segments lie on it from their lines, and lying on a path changes nothing about a segment. Not bound by segment lengths. Keyed by the importer's stable path id.

kind.description: A path whose kind the AppView doesn't know isn't indexed.

lines.description: The path's line in pieces, each an encoded polyline at precision 6 as feed.segment#line, of at least two positions: one piece, or several where the line is too long for one or has gaps.

source.description: Where the line came from, as feed.segment#source.

license.description: The licence of the line's data, as an SPDX identifier such as ODbL-1.0.

attribution.description: Who to credit for the line's data, as feed.segment#attribution.

sports.description: The sport groups the path is open to, from its source's tags; a segment of another group never lies on it. Absent means any, as for a road.
